title: Rexy Practice Level Manifest
description: Machine-readable contract a packaged Rexy practice level ships alongside itself, so Bridge can launch it and know what's controllable without level-specific code. See Docs/LevelManifest_Schema.md for the narrative version of this spec.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest schema. Bump on any breaking field change; Bridge should refuse to parse a majorversion it doesn't recognize rather than guess.

levelId.description: Stable unique identifier for this level, independent of display name. Used as Bridge's internal key (save data, library entries). Never change once shipped.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in Bridge's scene browser.

description.description: Short human-readable summary of what the scene is/does.

levelAsset.description: The UE package path to the level asset (e.g. /Game/PracticeLevels/PL_MinimalProof/PL_MinimalProof). Informational for creators/tooling; not needed by Bridge at runtime beyond the launch.mapArgument below, which is usually the same string.

launch.description: Everything Bridge needs to start the packaged executable correctly.

mapArgument.description: Bare command-line argument identifying which map to load, e.g. /Game/PracticeLevels/PL_MinimalProof/PL_MinimalProof. Required because a Bridge-hosted build may ship multiple levels behind one executable and none of them should rely on being the project default map.

commandLineFlags.description: Additional flags Bridge must always pass, e.g. ["-RCWebControlEnable"] for a remoteControl-path level. Empty array is valid (e.g. a future virtualController-only level needs none).

preLaunchRequirements.description: Conditions Bridge must satisfy BEFORE starting the process, because the engine only detects them at startup. Currently only relevant to controlPath=virtualController: RawInput has no hot-plug detection (see BridgeVirtualController_Spec.md §2 Finding A), so any virtual controllers this level expects must already be attached to the OS before the executable launches.

controlPath.description: Which mechanism Bridge uses to drive this level. 'remoteControl' is the current default (proven, see project_pl_minimalproof_complete memory). 'virtualController' is the target architecture, deprioritized pending BridgeVirtualController_Spec.md §2 Finding B. 'none' is valid for a level with no Bridge-driven control (e.g. gamepad-only).

remoteControl.description: Required when controlPath=remoteControl. Describes the RC preset and what it exposes.

presetAssetPath.description: UE package path to the RemoteControlPreset asset.

presetName.description: The preset's Name field, used in the RC HTTP URL: /remote/preset/{presetName}.

id.description: The RC exposed-property ID (from GET /remote/preset/{name}), used in PUT /remote/preset/{name}/property/{id}. Fetch fresh from the running instance rather than hardcoding — IDs are assigned when a property is exposed and are stable per-asset but opaque; don't guess them.

label.description: Human-readable label for a Bridge mapping UI, e.g. "DollyCamera Location".

rigName.description: Which entry in this manifest's top-level rigs[] this property belongs to.

propertyPath.description: The underlying UE property name, e.g. RelativeLocation. Informational — Bridge should drive by id, not reconstruct this path.

type.description: Shape of the value PUT expects, matching RC's own type names.

virtualController.description: Required when controlPath=virtualController. NOT YET LOAD-BEARING — see BridgeVirtualController_Spec.md §2 Finding B (RawInput did not reliably deliver analog values end-to-end in testing). Structure reflects the target design from §4/§7a of that spec; do not build against this until that finding is resolved.

controllerCount.description: How many virtual DS4-shaped devices this level expects Bridge to attach before launch.

channelsPerController.description: Per-controller channel budget. Defaults match RawInput's own ceiling per BridgeVirtualController_Spec.md §4 — a level needing more channels requests more controllers, not a bigger single device.

vendorId.description: Fixed VID Bridge should use for all controllers it creates for this level (pid.codes hobbyist allocation).

controllerIndex.description: Which controller (0-based, PID = vendorId base + this index + 1).

gamepadInput.description: Independent, lower-priority path: real physical gamepad support for users without Bridge. See feedback_rc_first_rawinput_later memory — explicitly NOT unified with the virtualController path above.

rigs.description: Equipment available in the scene, referenced by name from exposedProperties/axisMap above.

placement.description: fixed = single pre-placed position (current default, see RexyFilmAcademy_ConceptSpec.md §5.1a). markBased/freePlacement are future phases.
